proposed.text: For machine-graded lumber with moisture content between 16 percent and 28 percent, what does NSCP Section 622.2 say about design properties?

options.text: Obtain the design properties by direct interpolation.
Apply the green-lumber reductions for all pieces in this range.

rationale.correct: Section 622.2 states that for lumber with moisture content between 16 percent and 28 percent, design properties may be obtained by direct interpolation.
rationale.a: Not selected: dry-lumber properties apply to moisture content less than 16 percent.
rationale.b: Not selected: direct interpolation is the checked Section 622.2 rule.
rationale.c: Not selected: the explicit green-lumber reduction applies above 28 percent moisture content.
rationale.d: Not selected: the checked source gives an interpolation path.
rationale.takeaway: Use the moisture range before selecting dry, green, or interpolated properties.
rationale.source_boundary: Batch 162 uses only NSCP OCR page-0889.md lines 5-65 and page-0943.md lines 51-96.

proposed.explanation: The 16 percent to 28 percent moisture range uses direct interpolation under Section 622.2.
